How a piece moves through the artifacts

Each client can have five kinds of page. They follow the order you work in, so open them left to right.

  1. DS

    Design system

    The brand's rules for building: color, type, logo, layouts, modules.

    Open it before you start any piece for the brand.

  2. LIB

    Asset library

    Photos, tokens or modules pulled from approved work, with paths and rights.

    Search here before you crop, shoot or rebuild an asset.

  3. STU

    Studio

    A working tool paired with a Claude Project: the team makes pieces in the Project and turns them into final files here.

    Open it to render and download what the Project hands over.

  4. BRD

    Review board

    A working page for one campaign or one decision while it is in production.

    Use it during the job. When the job ships, it moves into the deliverables hub.

  5. HUB

    Deliverables hub

    Every finished job for the client, grouped by channel, ready for review.

    Send this link to the client or team. Each new job lands here.

Keeping this hub current

Every new artifact for a Power Digital client gets a card here in the same session it is published.

  1. Add an entry to hub/artifacts.json: client, type, status, title, URL, date, a two-line description and its main sections.
  2. Read the new artifact with the Artifact tool, then make its thumbnail from the saved HTML: 
    python hub/build_hub.py thumb <slug> <saved.html>
  3. Build the page: 
    python hub/build_hub.py
  4. Read this hub's live version, then republish hub/power-digital-hub.html to the same URL.
  5. When a board's job ships into a deliverables hub, set the board's status to superseded.

Status labels

Live approved and in use. Build from it.

In review waiting on a decision from the team or client.

Draft work in progress; check its open items before relying on it.

Superseded kept for history; its content lives somewhere newer.
